Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.2: Sign Reading 12.2.1 Sign Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 12.2.1 Sign Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to summarise information from a text? 2. How can one draw conclusions from a text?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 12.2.1 Sign Intensive Reading: Comprehension Strategies together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Critical thinking: interpretation and inference skill when the learner draws conclusions, make inferences, and writes a

summary.

• Learning to learn: the learner independently take part in the gallery walk and review each other’s work.

Values:
• Unity: the learners work in groups to summarise, display and review each other’s work.

Link to other subjects:

● The learner is able to relate reading skills in English to comprehension strategies are learnt in Kiswahili.
